route: Arbejdstilladelse på Færøerne (work and residence permit)

permit.applies: An application to the immigration authority (the order names Udlændingeservice, or through the landfoged); the authority is Útlendingastovan since 1 September 2024.
permit.first: A particular employment relationship to which the permit is tied.
permit.eligibility: når væsentlige beskæftigelsesmæssige eller erhvervsmæssige hensyn taler derfor
permit.pay: Salary and terms of employment must correspond to Faroese standards: pay, holidays and notice no worse than the standards of the professional field, and as a rule full-time (normally 40 hours a week); the Immigration Office assesses this.

sources.title: Bekendtgørelse nr. 636 af 7. juni 2010 om udlændinges adgang til Færøerne (Lovtidende)
sources.said: Stk. 2. Følgende udlændinge er for et tidsrum af tre måneder fra indrejsen på Færøerne fritaget for arbejdstilladelse på Fær- øerne: … 2) Kunstnere, herunder musikere, artister og lignende samt tilknyttet personale, såfremt de forud for arrangementet har indgået aftale med en arrangør på Færøerne. … Stk. 5. Arbejdstilladelse på Færøerne kan endvidere efter ansøgning gives til udlændinge med ophold uden for Færøer- ne, når væsentlige beskæftigelsesmæssige eller erhvervsmæs- sige hensyn taler derfor … gives til beskæftigelse i et bestemt arbejdsforhold. … En arbejdstilladelse på Færøerne efter § 35 har gyl- dighed i samme tidsrum som udlændingens opholdstilladelse på Færøerne, medmindre andet fremgår af tilladelsen. … forlængelse af arbejdstilladelse på Færøerne

sources.title: EURAXESS Faroe Islands, Work permit; rests on Útlendingastovan practice (no document named)
sources.said: Foreign citizens, except Nordic nationals, need a work and residence permit in order to work in the Faroe Islands. … Processing time for correctly completed applications for residence and work permit is normally within 3 months. … A residence and work permit for the Faroe Islands is normally granted with a validity of up to 1 year.

sources.title: Útlendingastovan (Faroese Immigration Office), Work in the Faroe Islands - applicants from third countries (saved l4w/files/p1c/FO-third.html)
sources.said: Your salary and terms of employment must correspond to Faroese standards Your salary and terms of employment must correspond to Faroese standards. This means that your salary, holiday entitlements, terms of notice etc. must not be inferior to the standards within the professional field where you are going to work. As a rule, your employment must be full-time, which normally means 40 hours work per week. … When your application for a residence and work permit has been submitted, the Immigration Office will assess whether your salary and terms of employment correspond to Faroese standards.

sources.title: Útlendingastovan, Exemption from the requirement of a work permit (saved l4w/files/p1c/FO-exempt.html)
sources.said: You can work in the Faroe Islands without a work permit if your stay is shorter than 3 months, and if you are: … an artist, musician, performer or similar, and you have made an agreement with an organiser on the Faroe Islands prior to your event,

note: The executive order on aliens' access to the Faroe Islands (nr. 636 of 7 June 2010) holds the rules: artists, musicians, performers and their staff with an engagement agreed in advance with an organiser in the Faroes need no work permit for three months from entry (§ 34(2)(2)); otherwise a work permit may be given to a foreigner living outside the Faroes where significant employment or business considerations call for it (§ 35(5)), for a particular employment (§ 36), valid as long as the residence permit (§ 38). Útlendingastovan (the Faroese authority since 1 September 2024) refuses this client (403 on utlendingastovan.fo and immigration.fo), so the processing time and term are from EURAXESS Faroe Islands, which names no primary; nyidanmark.dk's Faroese pages now answer 404. Whether the 2010 order still stands unchanged under the Faroese authority is unconfirmed (as at layer 3). Nordic citizens need no permit (EURAXESS). Read 2026-11-04 on the Immigration Office's own pages: the pay rule; the exemption already held (under three months) is confirmed, with the condition of an agreement with a Faroese organiser made before the event.
